title: 男性闭眼低头与扶手椅完整整件

source.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: reusable transparent paper-collage full-body medical-education character with his supporting chair. Reference image 1 is the identity, face, body proportions, exact clothing and art-style reference. Create the same middle-aged Chinese man, short salt-and-pepper dark hair, muted sage-green long-sleeved button shirt with rolled sleeves, dark navy-blue trousers and brown leather lace-up shoes. Change his pose and expression: he is unresponsive, eyes visibly fully closed, mouth gently closed, head slack and tilted down to his right, shoulders and arms relaxed, torso leaning against the back and arm of a supportive upholstered armchair. His hips must clearly rest on the actual cushion; back and head physically supported; both shoes reach one common floor baseline below the chair cushion. Natural coherent anatomy, two continuous arms and two hands, five natural fingers on each visible hand, two legs and shoes. Include the entire simple muted teal upholstered armchair with continuous seat/back/arm supports and four short wooden legs. The chair and patient are one coherent complete cutout designed together, three-quarter front view facing slightly toward screen right. Render a careful hand-cut textured paper collage with natural illustrative shading matching the reference, crisp hand-cut silhouette and subtle paper fiber. Actual transparent alpha background everywhere outside the complete man-and-chair group. Full head, shoes and chair legs safely within image with a small transparent margin. No room, floor, cast oval shadow, caregiver, text, device, food, cup, extra arms or detachable limbs. Do not exaggerate distress or portray graphic injury. The posture should clearly differ from the alert upright reference; do not depict a smiling or alert face.
